question: What is the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations, considering only the leaf-level items within each combination after fully expanding any nested packaging relationships?
sql:
-- Calculate the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations
WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree(root_id, current_id, qty_multiplier) AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pr.packaging_id, pr.packaging_id, 1
  FROM packaging_relations pr
  WHERE pr.packaging_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT pr2.packaging_id 
    FROM packaging_relations pr2
    WHERE pr2.packaging_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
  )
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT pt.root_id, pr.contains_id, pt.qty_multiplier * pr.qty
  FROM packaging_tree pt
  JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pt.current_id = pr.packaging_id
),
leaf_ids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations
),
leaf_quantities AS (
  SELECT pt.root_id, SUM(pt.qty_multiplier) AS total_leaf_qty
  FROM packaging_tree pt
  LEFT JOIN leaf_ids li ON pt.current_id = li.packaging_id
  WHERE li.packaging_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY pt.root_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_leaf_qty) AS avg_total_quantity
FROM leaf_quantities
